rationale: N-000118 specifies the value of scope_selector's layers field (equal to Q-DESC's scope_layers, one of L0-L5), while N-000149 states that scope_selector must be present (only for C nodes). N-000118 refines the requirement in N-000149 by specifying what the layers field must equal when the scope_selector is present.
